description: Every morning, checks Cliniko for the new referral on each request sent by "Send approved referral request": a new referral case created since, or the same case extended. When it's there, comments the details and completes the WorkQ item. If it hasn't arrived 5 days after the request, comments a reminder on the item and raises its priority (nothing is re-sent). Stops checking after 30 days or once the item is closed by hand.
